summary: repo.remote is now exported only as scheme://host[:port]/path or host:path without user info, query or fragment, and omitted for a local path or file:// origin; repo.name derives from the sanitized remote.
verified: vloop task gate T11 exited 0 and printed GATE OK.
notes: Schema: remote is now optional and a plain string (no null); Remote uses omitempty. scp-like user (git@) is dropped too. Local-path detection: no colon, slash/backslash before the colon, a one-letter Windows drive, or a ~ host.
